summary.text: Elizabeth Sanchez is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 94, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Berkeley County teacher, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she has taught in the county's schools for 21 years.

paragraphs.text: Elizabeth Sanchez said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that she has lived in Berkeley County her entire life and graduated from Berkeley County Schools.
She said she earned a bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice from West Liberty University and a Master of Arts in Teaching Spanish from Shepherd University.
She said she served for 13 years as an Equity and Inclusion Liaison for Berkeley County Schools.

Sanchez listed her key messages as investing in health care, public schools, child care and workers' rights, keeping costs down on utility bills and housing, and seeking local control of data centers.
